plan.thesis: Dip into the open, hold over two sessions.

checks.label: Liquidation runway
checks.headline: Liquidation at 226.64, 4.5% from entry.
checks.detail: A normal 72h move in NVDA is 3.1%. Liquidation sits 1.4 of those away. Under 2 is a coin toss on noise alone.

checks.label: Gap shock
checks.headline: A 7.2% move liquidates this position. That is a 4-sigma day for NVDA.
checks.detail: Shock size: 4-sigma day (7.2%). This flight crosses 3 opening bells; each is a chance to gap past a stop. Loss at the shock is 400.00 USDT against 209.90 planned.

checks.label: Earnings
checks.headline: Lands before NVDA reports on 17 NOV 2105Z (estimated date).
checks.detail: A hold that crosses a results date is judged on the gap, not on the stop.

checks.label: Regime replay
checks.headline: Flown through 84 past daily windows: 5 reached target, 32 stopped out, 0 liquidated.
checks.detail: Average result 10.53 USDT per flight, worst -225.10, best 470.43. 47 ran out of time before either level.

checks.label: Stop integrity
checks.headline: Stop 2.5% from entry, clear of noise and inside liquidation.
checks.detail: Stop at 231.39; a normal 72h move is 3.1%. Loss at the stop: 209.90 USDT including fees and slippage.

checks.label: Payoff
checks.headline: Risking 209.90 to make 470.43 USDT: 2.24 to 1.
checks.detail: This needs to win 31% of the time to break even. Of the 37 replayed flights that reached a level, 14% reached the target.

checks.label: Fees and funding
checks.headline: Round-trip fees 9.60 USDT, funding 0.00 over 72h.
checks.detail: Costs take 2% of the gross reward. Taker fee 0.06% per side, funding 0.0000% per 8h.

checks.label: Risk to account
checks.headline: 209.90 USDT at risk, 2.2% of a 9,395 USDT account.
checks.detail: Under 2% per flight leaves room to be wrong many times in a row. Over 5% does not.
